## Type of Change

## Security Checklist

- [ ] Zero credential leakage (no tokens/keys exposed to LLM, client, or logs)
- [ ] Mutating operations remain gated behind cryptographically signed HITL approvals
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, test credentials, or private URLs committed

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added or passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] Manual test performed against sample API (e.g. FakeRESTApi)
- [ ] Frontend build succeeds cleanly (`npm run build`)
